sources.entry: Paragon NTFS - Read/write access to NTFS in macOS Sierra.

summary.name: Microsoft NTFS for Mac by Paragon Software
summary.one_liner: A commercial NTFS driver for macOS that gives Macs full read/write access to Windows-formatted NTFS drives.
use_cases: Writing files to a Windows-formatted external drive from a Mac
Editing and deleting files on NTFS USB flash drives
Accessing a Boot Camp Windows partition from macOS
Mounting, verifying or repairing NTFS volumes on a Mac
Using an NTFS drive as a startup drive for Windows from the menubar
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a driver that lets macOS mount NTFS volumes in read/write mode so users can create, edit, copy, move, rename and delete files on drives formatted for Windows. It supports mounting, unmounting, verifying, formatting and repairing NTFS volumes, and automounts them at startup (this can be turned off). It is said to work on Intel and Apple Silicon (M1 through M4) Macs and to support NTFS versions from Windows NT 3.1 to Windows 11. Companion menubar and full apps are offered for quick volume operations and restarting into Windows.
notable: Claims up to six times faster than closest commercial competitors, based on a 2016 MacBook Pro test
Supports Apple Silicon M1 to M4 and macOS versions from Catalina through macOS 27 Golden Gate
Compatible with Boot Camp, VMware Fusion/Workstation, Parallels Desktop and TrueCrypt forks
Includes a lightweight menubar app for mount, unmount and verify
caveats: Page says a free trial is asked about in FAQ, but the free-trial answer text is not shown; purchase options and license details are not stated
Activation re-use limits are referenced in FAQ but the numbers are not given in the page text
Older macOS versions below 10.15 Catalina are addressed only by an FAQ question with no answer shown
